description: Small, large and empty files together, nested folders, and layouts that need more than one pack. The order of the entries is manifest order, byte by byte, and it alone decides which pack a file lands in and where.

cases.name: small, large and empty files mixed: only the small ones are packed, in order
nested folders: a-b sorts before a/x, so it is packed first
a pack boundary inside a folder: the 65th file of d1 opens pack 1, and d2 follows it there
three packs: 129 files of PACK_THRESHOLD - 1 bytes
three packs across folders, with large and empty files between them
files of many sizes that fill a pack unevenly
